svg.title: Aleutian/Subarctic Current: published width greater than400km
svg.desc: Onishi2001 describes the eastward Subarctic Current as wider than400km. An open circle at400 and rightward arrow show a strict lower constraint with unknown upper extent. No400km mean, finite range, width error, seasonal envelope or mapped edges. The westward Alaskan Stream is excluded.

g.text: Central subarctic North Pacific · width layer and epoch unspecified
Open threshold: greater than400, with no finite upper bound supplied.
Southern front is diffuse and moves between years; no annual range or error.
Study section/dates/reference depth are separate from this general width claim.
No scalar mean, width buffer, state passage or seasonal animation inferred.
